column5: STRONGEST FIGMA PARITY OF THE EIGHT GAMES. All 10 component frames verified `match`: Desktop 9178-4169, Desktop Start 9178-8146, Desktop Split 9178-6080, Mid Game button actions 9178-4037, Side Bet Tab 9178-8446, Side Bet Mobile 9178-10465, Mobile 9178-9840, Pointer 9178-8439 and 9178-10677 / 9178-12508. The 3 page frames (desktop 9003-117337, tablet 9003-119356, mobile 9003-119858) pass a numeric DOM audit with 0 missing sections at 1440/768/375. ★ THE 3:2-vs-EVEN-MONEY CONFLICT IS RESOLVED, AND THE FELT WON. The felt ribbon and the rules panel both promise "Blackjack pays 3 to 2"; the POINTS rail used to compute `ret = h.bet * 2.5` and then FLOOR it, so a natural on a 1-point stake returned floor(2.5) = 2 - even money. The felt was authoritative (3:2 is the advertised, industry-standard rule and the rail's own header comment claims it at supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts:2336), so the RAIL was underpaying, and the fix is `ret = Math.round(ret)` at supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts:2722 - the fraction is only ever exactly 0.5, so half-up never pays less than the advertised rule and every even stake is untouched. Landed in commit 7aa07b6d8 (2026-08-04) and VERIFIED LIVE: deployed points-game v99 (deployed 2026-08-05T01:36Z, after the 22:47Z commit) contains `Math.round(ret)` and zero occurrences of `Math.floor(ret)`. Side bets at index.ts:2846-2847 still floor, which is correct and must not be "unified": every Perfect Pairs / 21+3 multiplier is a whole number (25/12/6, 100/40/30/10/5), so the floor is a no-op there rather than a truncated half-point. ★ THE RULES PANEL WAS THE REMAINING LIAR, NOT THE FELT (fixed this pass, BlackjackGame.tsx). It printed FOUR numbers the rail contradicts: (a) "8 Deck Shoe" read `config?.numberOfDecks`, a field that does not exist on `BlackjackConfig`, so the `|| 8` fallback ALWAYS won while BOTH rails deal SIX decks (points-game `BJ_DECK_COUNT = 6`; game-settlement / blackjackGameService `createDeck(numDecks = 6)`) - a wrong deck count moves basic-strategy edge; (b) "Min Bet: {configMinBet} SKAI / Max Bet: {configMaxBet} SKAI" printed SKAI-scale bounds with a hardcoded SKAI suffix to a POINTS player whose real bounds are 1..1000 POINTS (`activeMinBet` / `activeMaxBet`); (c) "Insurance pays 2:1" sold a side bet POINTS never offers (`insuranceAvailable: false`, index.ts:3096); (d) "Blackjack pays 1.5:1 (3:2)" printed one ratio twice in two notations. All four now render the rail's real value. PlayTable.tsx's Blackjack card also claimed "surrender supported" and "~99.5% RTP" against the engine's own ~99.4% (0.63% edge, 6-deck H17) - both corrected. ★ 9003-118852 IS A NOT-READY RIVAL DUPLICATE - DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT. It and 9003-119356 carry a byte-identical title at the SAME 768 viewport, so no route, state or breakpoint can distinguish them; only one can render. Figma metadata settles which is the draft: 118852 nests a layer literally NAMED `Desktop` at width 708 (9003:118857) inside a 468-wide parent (9003:118856), overflowing it by 120px per side - the desktop board pasted at tablet width and never adapted - while 119356's board is the resized square `Tablet 6` 422x461 that matches the mobile frame 9003-119858. 118852's breadcrumb also reads `Blackjack` where 119356 and mobile read `BlackJack`. 119356 is the later node-id, is already built (BlackjackPageSections.tsx) and a prior sweep verified it `match`, so building 118852 would REGRESS a verified layout to reproduce an unadapted paste. Nothing below the board differs between the two. Both frames additionally draw content that must not be built: the retired `Practice mode off` toggle (9003:119199/119200 - practice mode was removed in a28c5b3, standing product rule), a game-details thumbnail whose layer is named `Cards ALT - Chicken` (9003:119080, another game's art), and five fabricated Community-wins rows (@CryptoQueen88 / Salem Kare / Ohamballa Joyson / @DeFiMaster2024, all with the identical $8,481.10 bet). The build correctly renders `useRecentBets` with honest loading/empty states instead. ★ SURRENDER IS NOT A FIGMA GAP - CONFIRMED AGAINST THE FRAME. 9178-4037 draws exactly four CTA/button children (9003:118981 Hit, 9003:118992 Stand, 9003:118999 Split, 9003:119008 Double); the tablet frame's action row repeats the same four. So the dead surrender path is a RULES-CONFIG DEFECT: `canSurrenderAction` (BlackjackGame.tsx) and `handleSurrender` are computed/defined and referenced by NO JSX, the keyboard shortcut was already removed, and the POINTS engine's VALID_ACTIONS set has no "surrender" so the call would 400. getBlackjackConfig() already pinned `surrenderAllowed: false` on its success path, but DEFAULT_CONFIG and the component's FALLBACK_BLACKJACK_CONFIG still said `true`, so one failed config fetch re-advertised it - both now pinned false, alongside `canResplitAces: false` (POINTS marks both ace-split hands standing; the on-chain `canSplit` never reads the flag at all). No surrender control was built. Insurance is the same shape (on-chain only, in no frame). ✅ PRACTICE MODE ALREADY REMOVED (a28c5b3) and the orphan tests/practiceBlackjack.test.ts is GONE - that catalog line was stale. Remaining known drift, unfixed and reported: the ADMIN rules config is decorative - neither backend reads blackjack_dealer_hits_soft17 or its siblings, and BlackjackConfigCard.tsx:158 / AdminJackpotConfig.tsx:275 still expose a blackjack payout ratio no rail consults, so an operator can still change what an admin is SHOWN without changing what is DEALT. ★ A REAL 2px PARITY DEFECT ON THE TABLET + MOBILE FRAMES, FIXED THIS PASS (BlackjackBetPanel.tsx). src/index.css forces `min-height: 44px` on every `button` at `max-width: 768px`, and min-height BEATS a `height` declaration - so the panel's three `h-[42px]` control groups (the 1/2 / 2X / Max chips, the currency segments, and the Manual | Side Bet tabs, whose halves are 34px inside a 42px track) all rendered 44px tall at 768 and below, against Figma's 42. Worst case was the tab row: a 44px child forced through a 42px parent. Fixed with the sanctioned per-control opt-out `:not(.no-min-size)` on those buttons; index.css itself is NOT touched. This affects 9178-9840, 9178-10465 and both 768 page frames - it is invisible at 1440, which is why a desktop-only screenshot sweep passed them.
